# ChartGenie.xyz — a chart maker for posts

> Paste numbers, get a post-ready chart. Free, no account, everything runs in the browser and charts are autosaved in that browser.

## What it does
- **Paste anything**: spreadsheet cells, a CSV, or a sentence like “Revenue grew from 12k in Jan to 34k in Jun” become rows; units (%, $, k/M) are detected and you confirm the rows before charting.
- **Chart suggestions**: three ranked looks from the shape of the data (two points → before/after, dates → line, parts of 100 → donut, a drop-off → funnel).
- **19 chart looks**: bars, ranked bars, stacked bars, 100% stacked, line, area, stacked line and area, pie, donut, radar, scatter, heat grid, rule chart, gauge, conversion funnel, KPI headline and a 2×2 priority matrix.
- **Four post sizes**: 16:9 (X / web, 1600×900), 1:1 (LinkedIn, 1080×1080), 9:16 (Story, 1080×1920) and 4:3 (deck, 1600×1200), with platform crop-zone overlays.
- **Post-ready checks**, computed from the rendered chart: label contrast (APCA), minimum text size at the smallest export, nothing inside a platform crop zone, alt text present.
- **Insights and captions**: facts computed from the rows (largest, share, ratio, average, change over time) can be pinned on the chart as callouts; a caption is drafted on the device in three tones. If the browser ships a built-in language model it can rewrite the caption on the device; nothing is sent to a server.
- **Export set**: one click renders PNG and SVG for every chosen size, plus caption.txt and alt-text.txt, zipped. Fonts are embedded in the SVG.
- **Share links**: the whole chart travels inside the link. Links of the form /s/<state> unfurl as a preview card; the card is rendered on request and nothing is stored. A “Remix with your numbers” button opens the same look with blank values.
- **My charts, Series and Brand**: saved charts with real thumbnails, recurring charts that ask for next period’s numbers with last period faded behind, and a brand kit (palette, colour-blind-safe variant, handle, logo) — all saved in this browser. A JSON backup can be exported and restored.

## Routes
- https://chartgenie.xyz/ — templates (returning people land on /new)
- https://chartgenie.xyz/new — paste anything
- https://chartgenie.xyz/pie-chart-maker — pie chart maker
- https://chartgenie.xyz/bar-graph-maker — bar graph maker
- https://chartgenie.xyz/convert-excel-to-chart — spreadsheet rows to a chart
- https://chartgenie.xyz/sitemap.xml

## Privacy
Charts are edited in the browser and autosaved to this browser's storage as you edit. Share links carry the chart data inside the address so a preview card can be rendered on request; nothing is stored server-side. Site analytics runs without chart titles, labels, values, captions or share links in events.
